name: Tocainide Hydrochloride

similar.name: Mexiletine
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, liver harm and serious skin reactions

similar.name: Bupivacaine
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, misuse or addiction and nerve and brain harm

similar.name: Mefenamic Acid
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems and heart harm

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Tocainide Hydrochloride low scores for both liver and heart risk [M]. Other drugs that are chemically similar to it have the most severe type of safety alerts, known as boxed warnings, in the United States [3][4][5]. For example, the related drugs Mexiletine and Bupivacaine have warnings for heart harm, while Mefenamic Acid has warnings for heart, stomach or bowel, and nerve or brain harm [3][4][5]. Mexiletine also has warnings for liver and skin harm, and Bupivacaine warns of misuse and nerve damage [3][4].
